 Most of the nation returned to standard time Sunday morning, and Congress could decide as early as next month whether it will be the last time people have to change their clocks.
 President Donald Trump wants year-round daylight saving time. The U.S. House voted overwhelmingly in July for the change. Lots of Democrats and Republicans are behind the idea.
